goal: Reconcile SDX Vol 4 Mars sovereignty with the Syndicate Twelve
body: Recovered and persisted the accessible Twelve-seat facts plus Dave's Vol. 4 expansion. Confirmed: ARES = kinetic/ground enforcement; APOLLO/Heliox = narrative/media/perception; OBSIDIAN = cyber/surveillance/data. Twelve intermarry and share dynastic lines; internal blocs include Erasure, Reclamation, Pragmatists. New Vol. 4 direction: SDX/X99 is an effectively undead, extremely long-lived ruler with ultimate Mars power, potentially commanding the Twelve and possibly occupying the Zeus identity. Zeus remains candidate until throne/succession reconciliation. First half of Vol. 4 may follow SDX as though she were X². Continue recovering the remaining nine Seats from older stores without inventing names.

relay.note: Resolved by whoart: Twelve-seat recovery captured in shard:25729@db9 and shard:22644@db8 (ARES=kinetic, APOLLO/Heliox=narrative/media, OBSIDIAN=cyber/data, Hermes=Nyx's father, Hephaestus=Ember Veil foundry). SDX/Zeus reconciliation still CANON_CANDIDATE (shard:27175@db4), not locked. 6 of 12 seats remain unnamed — do not invent, keep recovering from old stores.
